## About
Williams & Co. International Realty is an Atlanta real estate firm led by Denise Williams. Buyers who have worked with us mention agents by name: Denise, Zachary Taylor, Phyllis Roberts and Ashley Carrier.
Whether you are buying your first home or relocating to Atlanta for work, we aim to make the process clear and calm. We explain market pricing, cover the small details and answer every question along the way.
Our clients rate us 4.9 from 112 Google reviews.

## Services
- Home buying: Guidance through the full home buying process, with an agent by your side from search to closing.
- Relocating to Atlanta: Help for buyers moving to the Atlanta area, including finding a home in the right location.
- International real estate: One client shared that he is exploring international real estate investment with Denise Williams.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with first-time home buyers?
A: Yes. One first-time buyer wrote that she was nervous at the start and that Denise helped her feel at ease throughout.

Q: Which agents will I be working with?
A: Reviewers mention Denise Williams, Zachary Taylor, Phyllis Roberts and Ashley Carrier. One described Ashley as reassuring and very detailed.

Q: When is the office open?
A: Monday through Wednesday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Thursday and Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
